2. In the Criminal Revision Application, the applicant herein original accused has prayed to release him on bail by suspending the sentence imposed by the learned Third Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Panchmahals at Godhra, vide judgment and order passed in Criminal Case No.1661 of 2002 dated 21.8.2012, which is confirmed by the learned Second Additional Sessions Judge,
Panchmahals at Godhra by the judgment and order passed in Criminal Appeal No.28 of 2012 dated 27.1.2017, whereby learned trial Judge has convicted and sentenced the applicant for the offence punishable under Sections 16, 7(2), 7(3) of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act read with Rule 50 of the PF Rule.

He, therefore, prays to grant the bail to the applicant by suspending the sentence till disposal of the present Revision Application.
